description: Astronomers combined observations from the Hubble and Euclid space telescopes to produce a detailed image of the Cat’s Eye Nebula. The composite view reveals intricate shells, jets, and a faint outer ring formed from earlier eruptions of the dying star.
title: Hubble and Euclid Reveal Stunning New View of Cat’s Eye Nebula

description: Samsung is expected to unveil the Galaxy Z Flip 8 alongside the Galaxy Z Fold 8 in July. A report suggests the clamshell foldable could retain a 4,300mAh typical battery, similar to the Galaxy Z Flip 7, using two cells rated at 1,150mAh and 3,024mAh. Battery life may still improve through efficiency gains. The phone is tipped to run on the 2nm Exynos 2600 chip and may not bring major camera upgrades.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 8 Battery Details Leaked; Might Have Same Capacity as the Galaxy Z Flip 7

description: Silent Hill 2 remake has surpassed 5 million copies sold, Konami and Bloober Team have confirmed. The survival horror game released on PS5 and PC in 2024 and launch on Xbox Series S/X last year. The sales figure includes digital and physical units shipped, store downloads and subscription services, Konami confirmed.
title: Silent Hill 2 Remake Has Surpassed 5 Million Copies Sold, Konami Announces

description: Apple’s first foldable iPhone has appeared in several leaks detailing its possible pricing, storage options, and hardware. A tipster claims the handset could launch in China with 256GB, 512GB, and 1TB variants priced at CNY 15,999 (roughly Rs. 2,14,400), CNY 17,999 (roughly Rs. 2,41,100), and CNY 19,999 (roughly Rs. 2,67,900). Estimated US pricing could start at about $1,999 (roughly Rs. 1,84,700). Another tipster suggests Apple may call the device the iPhone Ultra, while reports also indicate Samsung could supply the 12GB RAM modules.
title: Apple's Foldable Tipped to Launch as 'iPhone Ultra'; Price and Memory Configurations Leaked

description: Google Pixel 10a brings modest improvements over last year’s Pixel 9a. It runs Android 16 and features a dual rear camera setup. Positioned as an affordable option, it competes with Apple’s iPhone 16e, Apple’s lowest‑priced model with Apple Intelligence. All three phones include OLED displays and support wireless charging.
title: Google Pixel 10a vs Pixel 9a vs iPhone 16e: Price in India, Specifications and Features Compared

description: The Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra was launched in February as the company’s flagship smartphone. While it brought several notable hardware changes and artificial intelligence (AI)-backed enhancements, the headlining feature is touted to be the Privacy Display. Built directly into the handset's screen, it is designed to limit side-angle visibility without affecting the user's viewing experience.
title: How to Enable Privacy Display on the Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: HSBC and Standard Chartered could become among the first banks to receive stablecoin issuer licences in Hong Kong under the city’s new regulatory framework. Reports suggest regulators may grant initial approvals soon as authorities move forward with plans to expand the city’s regulated digital asset ecosystem.
title: HSBC, Standard Chartered Said to Be First Recipients of Stablecoin Licences in Hong Kong

description: iQOO Z11 is now available for pre-order in China via the Vivo online store. Additionally, iQOO Product Manager Xing Cheng has shared an image of the smartphone to reveal the design of the upcoming smartphone. It is shown in a blue colourway, which resembles iQOO Z11 Turbo’s Canglang Fuguang (translated from Chinese) colour option. The smartphone is confirmed to be launched in the country with a price tag between CNY 2,000 (roughly Rs. 27,000) and CNY 3,000 (about Rs. 40,000).
title: iQOO Z11 Design Teased as Pre-Orders Open in China: Expected Features, Specifications

description: Apple recently launched the MacBook Neo as its first-ever low-cost laptop. With reviews praising the laptop for its premium build and commendable performance, despite its relatively affordable price, it has now drawn attention for another factor altogether. A teardown video of the MacBook Neo suggests that it may be one of the most repairable laptops Apple has made in years, featuring a modular design and minimal adhesive, resulting in easily replaceable components.
title: MacBook Neo Teardown Suggests It May Be Apple’s Most Repairable Laptop in Several Years

description: The blue check badge was previously only added to the profiles of people who might be targets for impersonation, including journalists, celebrities and other public figures. Elon Musk’s 2022 decision to make it a for-pay feature, the commission argued, misled X users into falsely believing that verified accounts were trustworthy.
title: Musk’s X to Alter Verification System in Europe, Commission Says

description: OpenAI is reportedly working on developing an alternative to Microsoft’s GitHub. As per the report, the San Francisco-based artificial intelligence (AI) giant is in the early stages of developing the code hosting platform. It is said that the company decided to make the product after facing several disruptions on GitHub due to platform-based outages.
title: OpenAI Is Reportedly Developing a Code Hosting Platform to Take on Microsoft’s GitHub

description: Realme 16T 5G and Realme P4R 5G could be launched soon in India by the Chinese smartphone maker, as a tipster claims that the handsets are confirmed to arrive in the country. The Realme 16T 5G could be offered in 6GB + 128GB, 8GB + 128GB, and 8GB + 256GB RAM and storage configurations. Meanwhile, the Realme P4R 5G is said to go on sale in 4GB + 128GB, 6GB + 128GB, and 6GB + 256GB variants. Both handsets are tipped to be available in the country in three distinct colour options each.
title: Realme 16T 5G, Realme P4R 5G India Launch Tipped Along With Colour Options, Storage Variants

description: The Samsung Galaxy Buds 4 Pro are the new flagship earbuds from the company. The earbuds offer a new premium design language, which makes them more comfortable. The Galaxy Buds 4 Pro are available in different colour options. Check out the first impressions to know more about the device.
title: Samsung Galaxy Buds 4 Pro First Impressions

description: Organisers of the Token2049 crypto conference have postponed the Dubai edition of the event to 2027 after citing security concerns and regional uncertainty. The summit was originally scheduled for April 2026 but will now take place in April 2027. Token2049 is one of the largest global gatherings for the cryptocurrency and Web3 industry and usually attracts thousands of founders, investors, and blockchain executives.
title: Token2049 Crypto Conference Delays Dubai Summit to 2027 Over Security Concerns

description: Vashikaranam is a supernatural Hindi series about a woman who controls a village through black magic, spreading fear and mistrust. The thriller premieres March 16, 2026 on SonyLIV and Sony Entertainment Television.
title: Vashikaranam OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch This Supernatural Drama Online?

description: The team behind the TRUMP memecoin has announced a new exclusive event for the project’s biggest token holders. The top 297 investors will be invited to a conference and gala luncheon with US President Donald Trump at his Mar-a-Lago estate in Florida. The announcement triggered a surge in the token’s price, which jumped more than 28 percent in 24 hours before stabilising.
title: Donald Trump’s Memecoin Rises After Project Announces Exclusive Event for Top Token Holders

description: Nothing Phone 4a Pro, OnePlus 15R, and Vivo V70 5G compete in India’s upper mid-range smartphone segment. The Nothing Phone 4a Pro features a 6.83-inch AMOLED display, Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 chip, Glyph Matrix lighting, and a 5,400mAh battery. The OnePlus 15R offers flagship-level performance with the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 processor, a 165Hz AMOLED display, and a large 7,400mAh battery. Meanwhile, the Vivo V70 5G highlights its Zeiss-tuned triple camera setup, 6.59-inch AMOLED display, and 6,500mAh battery with 90W fast charging support.
title: Nothing Phone 4a Pro vs OnePlus 15R vs Vivo V70 5G: Price in India, Specifications and Features Compared

description: The US Treasury has sanctioned individuals and entities tied to a North Korea-linked IT worker scheme that allegedly used fake identities to secure remote tech jobs and funnel earnings through cryptocurrency. Officials say the network helped generate illicit revenue for the North Korean regime.
title: US Treasury Department Sanctions North Korea-Linked Network Over Crypto IT Worker Fraud

description: Anthropic, on Thursday, introduced a new feature for its artificial intelligence (AI) chatbot, Claude. The new capability allows it to generate in-line visualisations, including interactive charts and diagrams in response to user queries. The visual information appears directly on the chat page and does not require any coding capabilities of the chatbot.
title: Anthropic’s Claude AI Gets Interactive Charts and Visualisations in Responses

description: The British Academy of Film and Television Arts (BAFTA) announced the nominations for the BAFTA Games Awards 2026 on Wednesday. Acclaimed RPG Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 led with 12 nominations, following by nine nods for Dispatch. BAFTA Games Awards 2026 will be held on April 17 in London.
title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 Leads BAFTA Games Awards 2026 Nominations With 12 Nods

description: Honor could be preparing the Honor X80 GT with a massive 13,080mAh battery, according to a Huawei Central report citing a Weibo tipster. The phone is reportedly in development and may launch in the first half of the year. If accurate, the battery would be one of the largest in a mainstream smartphone. Honor has already released devices with large batteries, including the 10,000mAh Honor Win series and the 10,080mAh Honor Power 2. The move also reflects a broader trend among Chinese brands experimenting with larger batteries.
title: Honor X80 GT Could Launch in China Soon With a Massive 13,080mAh Battery, Tipster Claims

description: iQOO has launched its latest offering, the Z11x 5G, in India, a time when its overall strategy for its smartphones in the country seems to be changing. With reports suggesting that no Neo series phones are expected this year, it seems to have left a void in its upper mid-range segment, and its focus on its Z series seems to be ongoing. The recently launched iQOO Z11x 5G is said to be providing users with a balanced experience through its features and design. Based on initial impressions, it looks to cater to users who want a reliable experience without any experimentation.
title: iQOO Z11x 5G First Impressions

description: Lava Bold 2 5G has been launched in India by the Noida-based tech firm as the latest model in its Bold series. The smartphone is scheduled to go on sale in the country exclusively via Amazon on March 19. It will be available for purchase in Feather White and Midnight Black colour options. The handset is powered by a MediaTek Dimensity 7000-series chipset, along with 6GB of RAM and 128GB of UFS 3.1 onboard storage. Lava’s new Bold series smartphone is backed by a 5,000mAh battery. It ships with Android 15.
title: Lava Bold 2 5G Launched in India With 5,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Google’s Gemini AI task automation feature has started rolling out to the Samsung Galaxy S26 series, according to a report. Showcased by Google during the Galaxy Unpacked 2026 event on February 25, the feature is confirmed to also arrive on the Pixel 10 series phones. The feature allows users to delegate tedious tasks to the AI assistant. It is capable of executing tasks in the background in a secure and virtual window, allowing users to access other apps while Gemini runs the task assigned by the user. For example, users can ask Gemini to book a cab or order lunch for them while they are browsing social media apps.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Series Reportedly Gets Gemini’s AI-Backed Task Automation Tool Upgrade

description: Truecaller on Thursday announced Family Protection in India. It is a new feature aimed at collectively safeguarding households against scam and fraud calls, creating what the company calls a “Safety Circle” for up to five people within a household. As part of the move, the caller identification app is onboarding a shared safety system that allows families to monitor and manage potential threats across multiple devices.
title: Truecaller Launches Family Protection Feature With Support for Ending Suspected Scam Calls

description: Adobe on Thursday announced that its long-time chief executive officer (CEO), Shantanu Narayen, plans to step down from the role once a successor is appointed. Narayen, who has led the company for 18 years, will continue to serve as Chair of the Board after the leadership transition. As per the multinational computer software company, this move is part of the succession planning process as it prepares for its next phase of growth.
title: Adobe CEO Shantanu Narayen to Step Down After 18 Years, Will Remain Board Chair

description: Bitcoin traded near the $72,000 level on Friday as improving macro sentiment and steady ETF inflows supported the crypto market. Analysts said US jobless claims meeting expectations helped calm investor concerns, while institutional demand continued to anchor prices. Ethereum and major altcoins also moved higher, though traders remain cautious as key resistance levels continue to cap further upside.
title: Bitcoin Price Touches One-Week High Amidst Ongoing Macroeconomic Concerns

description: Microsoft introduced Copilot Health, a new artificial intelligence (AI)-powered medical insights feature, on Thursday. It is a separate, dedicated space within Copilot where users can add their health data from various sources, and then let the AI chatbot analyse the data to provide personalised information. Users will also be able to ask questions about their ailments and overall well-being.
title: Microsoft Makes a Move Towards AI-Powered Healthcare With Copilot Health

description: Nothing Phone 4a and Phone 4a Pro are now on sale in India after launching on March 5. The smartphones feature AMOLED displays with up to 144Hz refresh rate and are powered by Snapdragon 7 series chipsets. They run Android 16-based Nothing OS 4.1 and support up to 12GB RAM and 256GB storage. The devices bring Glyph lighting interfaces, triple rear cameras with 50-megapixel sensors, and 5,400mAh batteries with 50W charging. They start at Rs. 31,999 for the Phone 4a and Rs. 39,999 for the Phone 4a Pro.
title: Nothing Phone 4a, Nothing Phone 4a Pro Go on Sale in India: Price, Offers, Features

description: Oppo has confirmed that the Find X9 Ultra will launch globally alongside China. A new leak suggests the phone could feature a 200-megapixel Sony LYTIA 901 main camera, a 50-megapixel ultrawide lens, and dual periscope telephoto cameras offering 3x and up to 10x optical zoom. It may also include a 3.2-megapixel colour restoration sensor and a 50-megapixel selfie camera. The device is tipped to offer a 6.82-inch 2K 120Hz OLED display, a 7,000mAh+ battery, a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, and a 16GB+1TB variant.
title: Oppo Find X9 Ultra Camera Details Surface Online Again Ahead of Launch in China and Global Debut

description: Tinder, the US-based online dating platform, unveiled various trust and safety features, four new discovery modes, profile redesign functionalities, and more on Thursday, during the Tinder Sparks 2026 keynote livestream. The company has upgraded its ‘Does This Bother You?’ and ‘Are You Sure?’ trust and safety features, allowing its large language model (LLM) to understand context and detect harmful messages. Moreover, Tinder is bringing a new Events tab, which will allow users to discover local events so they can meet in real life.
title: Tinder Introduces Upgraded AI Safety Features, New Astrology Mode and More During Sparks Keynote

description: Apple is reducing its commission rates for developers on the App Store in China, the company announced on Thursday. Following discussions with local regulators, the Cupertino-based tech giant’s revised structure will lower the standard commission and also reduce fees for developers enrolled in certain programmes, including the App Store Small Business Program. The move comes amid growing competition from domestic app ecosystems like Xiaomi, along with increasing regulatory scrutiny in China.
title: Apple Cuts App Store Commission in China Amid Competition From Domestic Ecosystems

description: Google on Thursday announced a new feature for Google Maps, which lets users ask complex, real-world questions about places directly within the app. The feature, dubbed Ask Maps, is said to have deeper artificial intelligence (AI) integration and adds new Gemini-powered capabilities in Google Maps. Following its rollout, users can ask natural language queries and receive AI-generated answers grounded in Maps data.
title: Google Maps Gets Gemini-Powered ‘Ask Maps’ Feature; Adds Immersive Navigation for Driving
